actually or truly or to an extreme
examples: it's quite the thing to do

quite a.definition: of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative)

quite a little.definition: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
examples: he made a mint on the stock market
see the rest of the winners in our huge passel of photos

quite an.definition: of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative)

quits.definition: on equal terms by payment or requital

quittance.definition: a document or receipt certifying release from an obligation or debt
payment of a debt or obligation

quitter.definition: a person who gives up too easily

quiver.definition: an almost pleasurable sensation of fright
examples: a frisson of surprise shot through him
the shaking of his fingers as he lit his pipe

quiver.definition: move back and forth very rapidly
move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
examples: the city pulsated with music and excitement
the shaking of his fingers as he lit his pipe

quixotic.definition: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic
examples: as quixotic as a restoration of medieval knighthood
a wild-eyed dream of a world state
sent to jail for two years, he has quixotically refused to clear himself by betraying his colleagues

quiz.definition: an examination consisting of a few short questions

examples: The teacher tests us every week
We got quizzed on French irregular verbs

quiz program.definition: a game show in which contestants answer questions

quizmaster.definition: the host or chairman of a radio or tv quiz show or panel game

quizzer.definition: someone who administers a test to determine your qualifications

examples: "his face wore a somewhat quizzical almost impertinent air"- Lawrence Durrell

quizzical.definition: perplexed (as if being expected to know something that you do not know)

quizzically.definition: in a quizzical and questioning manner
examples: they looked quizzically at the doctor

qum.definition: a city in northwestern Iran; a place of pilgrimage for Shiite Muslims

quo warranto.definition: a hearing to determine by what authority someone has an office or franchise or liberty

quodlibet.definition: an issue that is presented for formal disputation

quoin.definition: expandable metal or wooden wedge used by printers to lock up a form within a chase
(architecture) solid exterior angle of a building; especially one formed by a cornerstone

quoit.definition: game equipment consisting of a ring of iron or circle of rope used in playing the game of quoits

quoits.definition: a game in which iron rings (or open iron rings) are thrown at a stake in the ground in the hope of encircling it

examples: the once capital of the state

quonset hut.definition: a prefabricated hut of corrugated iron having a semicircular cross section

quoratean.definition: a group of languages of the Hokan family

quorum.definition: a gathering of the minimal number of members of an organization to conduct business

examples: all the salesmen met their quota for the month

quota.definition: a proportional share assigned to each participant

examples: the quota for Japanese imports was negotiated

quotability.definition: the quality of being worthy of being quoted

quotable.definition: able or fit to be repeated or quoted
examples: what he said was not repeatable in polite company
he comes up with so many quotable phrases

quotable.definition: suitable for or worthy of quotation
examples: his remarks are not quotable in mixed company

quotation.definition: a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage
examples: the student's essay failed to list several important citations
the acknowledgments are usually printed at the front of a book
the article includes mention of similar clinical cases

quotation.definition: a passage or expression that is quoted or cited
a statement of the current market price of a security or commodity
the practice of quoting from books or plays etc.
examples: since he lacks originality he must rely on quotation

quotation mark.definition: a punctuation mark used to attribute the enclosed text to someone else

quote.definition: a punctuation mark used to attribute the enclosed text to someone else
a passage or expression that is quoted or cited

examples: He quoted the Bible to her

quote.definition: refer to for illustration or proof
examples: He said he could quote several instances of this behavior
Here the author is quoting his colleague

quoter.definition: a communicator (speaker or writer) who uses quotations

quotidian.definition: found in the ordinary course of events
examples: "there's nothing quite like a real...train conductor to add color to a quotidian commute"- Anita Diamant

quotient.definition: the ratio of two quantities to be divided

quotient verdict.definition: an improper and unacceptable kind of compromise verdict

quran.definition: the sacred writings of Islam revealed by God to the prophet Muhammad during his life at Mecca and Medina

qurush.definition: 20 qurush equal 1 riyal in Saudi Arabia

qwerty keyboard.definition: the standard typewriter keyboard; the keys for Q, W, E, R, T, and Y are the first six from the left on the top row of letter keys
